# Copilot Instructions

Read these project docs before making changes:

- `README.md` — current server/API/environment documentation
- `flow.md` — request flow for `/chat` and `/use-model`
- `AGENTS.md` — repo-specific agent notes and deployment location
- `foundation.md` — product-direction notes for training and memory

`prompt.md` contains historical requirements and is not the canonical API reference.

When updating behavior, update the docs in the same change.
